title: Nano empire 2
summary: Once, nanobots gave humans godlike power to create worlds, limited only by their imagination. But now the Creators have lost control of the creations! You, a humble starship captain, are all that stands between the galaxy and destruction. Nano Empire 2 is an incremental sandbox text adventure, featuring 30 handcrafted worlds where dreams have turned into nightmares. Endless beach parties suddenly have a leviathan problem. Crystal automata rise up against the Queen of Light. A rogue nanobot factory produces strangely beautiful horrors. A royal family of sentient trees has forgotten how to reproduce. There are also vampires, inverted merpeople, and a Great Clown Head. And of course, all these factions are at war... Without nanobots meeting everyone's needs automatically, ship captains like you are about to become the most important people in the galaxy. Transport resources to populations who desperately need them, take sides in wars or profit from both sides, befriend eccentric creatures, grow your fleet, and maybe even research a way to undo the damage. Every world has a dramatically different vision for the future of civilization, and your choices will determine which one is successful. You don't need to have played Nano Empire 1 to enjoy this game, but returning players will notice many recurring characters... -Will Peter Frederick ever grow up and care about something other than partying? -Will Zithguul the giant scorpion escape from the Petting Zoo? -What will happen with Roland, Carla, and the ongoing conflict between the Underworld and the Core?* Features: -100% human-written. No generative AI was used to make this game. -Simple and elegant resource management as in Nano Empire 1. All the storytelling of an open world space opera with none of the tedious inventory management. -30 factions playing out a dynamic simulation of economy, war, and culture. Every action you take affects the balance of power. -Several days of idle gameplay. Each world unlocks new activities over time as it grows. -Collect artifacts and allies with world-shattering effects (sometimes literally). -Over 40 possible endings! (You can experience multiple endings without having to restart the game every time. A handy Ending Tracker is included.) -Play the complete game for free with no ads. An in-app purchase is available to unlock optional worlds and bonus resources. -Fully accessible with VoiceOver. *If you haven't already figured it out, this game takes place after the most interesting ending of Nano Empire: the one with the apocalypse... Ratings & Reviews

title: FruitPot Adventures
summary: A luxury hotel, a missing necklace, and a resourceful detective. Enjoy hours of fun in a free mystery adventure you can play offline, with VoiceOver support. Join James F. Pot as he investigates the Golden Lion Hotel. Talk to its quirky guests, uncover clues, try on disguises, and combine items to solve situations that are as puzzling as they are hilarious. HOURS OF FUN AND CLEVER PUZZLES Explore the hotel and tackle logic, memory, and sound puzzles. Every conversation and every item could help you move forward. Sometimes you’ll need a tool. Sometimes, a disguise. And almost always, a little ingenuity. PLAY OFFLINE, AT YOUR OWN PACE Play without an internet connection and take your investigation wherever you go. Automatic saving keeps your progress safe, and three save slots let you organize your adventures. ACCESSIBILITY THAT LETS YOU EXPLORE YOUR WAY • VoiceOver support. • Descriptions of scenes, objects, and characters. • Guided controls to browse, select, and describe elements around you. • Customizable voice narration. • Separate volume controls for music, ambient sounds, voices, and sound effects. • Options for larger buttons and more vivid colors. • Map zoom to explore the details. • Reduced animation and outlines for interactive areas. FOR IPHONE AND IPAD Enjoy retro-style scenery, music, and memorable characters, with text in English, Spanish, French, German and Italian. THE COMPLETE GAME IS FREE No ads and no payments required to continue the story. You can finish the entire adventure for free. If you’d like to support future adventures, you’ll find four optional contribution levels under the star on the main menu. Each level unlocks a supporter emblem, without gameplay advantages or content needed to finish the adventure. Contributions require an internet connection to the App Store. There’s a mystery waiting at the Golden Lion. James F. Pot has just arrived.

title: Sonnounce
summary: Send announcements to the Sonos speakers in your house – in your own voice. Pick the speakers you want, hold the button down while you talk, and let go. The announcement plays right away. While the announcement plays, the music is turned down, and afterwards it comes back up. The announcement itself plays at the volume the speaker is already set to. NO ACCOUNT. NO CLOUD. NO SUBSCRIPTION. The app talks directly to the speakers on your own network. The sound is recorded on the phone, and the speaker fetches it from there. Your voice never leaves the house. An announcement can be up to five minutes long. FROM YOUR WRIST With Apple Watch you can record an announcement straight from your wrist. The watch passes it on through your iPhone. SHORTCUTS Type a text in Shortcuts, and the phone reads it aloud on your speakers. It is read aloud in the language the app is set to. Use it in automations, for example when dinner is ready or when someone rings the doorbell. You can also have the most recent announcement repeated. AWAY FROM HOME With a Homey Pro you can send announcements home even when you are out. This requires the Sonnounce app to be installed on your Homey as well. If you have a VPN to your home, you can also send announcements that way. SAVE THE ANNOUNCEMENTS With a Homey you can save every announcement sent in the house. They are kept on your own Homey at home – not in the cloud – and you can download them to your iPhone. Requires Sonos speakers on the same Wi-Fi as the phone.

title: My Little Window
summary: Grow a tiny garden on a sunlit windowsill. Plant a seed, watch it sprout in real time, and come back to a bloom. No ads, ever. My Little Window is a gentle idle garden that grows even while the app is closed. There is no failure here. Nothing withers, nothing rushes you, and every plant is happy to wait. GROW IN REAL TIME Seeds mature on their own schedule, from a one minute pothos to a full day jade. Water them, mist them, give them sun. Well tended plants sell for more. COLLECT THEM ALL Every home has twenty species for your Plant Book, 240 in all, and every one hides a rare variant with its own look. Open seed packs, chase rares, and cross-breed two seeds for a chance at something special. A JOURNEY OF LITTLE HOMES Complete a home to travel down the path to the next: twelve homes across four chapters, each with its own window, its own plants and its own rooms. • The Meadow: a woodland cabin, a suburban flower garden and a farmhouse kitchen garden. • Warm Shores: a beach cottage, a harbor and a lighthouse, where messages in bottles wash up on your sill. • Country Lanes: an English cottage garden, a prairie homestead and a hillside burrow, where bees visit your blooms and leave new seeds. • Sun & Stone: a Tuscan vineyard house, a Moroccan riad and a desert adobe, where every bloom you sell becomes a tile for a mosaic wall. More homes are on the way. MAKE IT YOURS Coins from your blooms furnish five cozy rooms in every home. Every armchair, shelf, and lamp gives your garden a lasting boost, from faster growth to luckier packs. A LIVING WINDOW Morning light, golden hour, starry nights, and quiet rain move across your window through the day. Animal friends wander by. A daily gift waits each morning, and streaks make it sweeter. KIND BY DESIGN No ads. No energy bars. No pressure. Gems can speed things up, but everything in the game can be earned for free. Pull up a chair by the window. Your garden is already growing.

title: Treblo - AI Music
summary: Make songs with the world's best AI music model. For free. No limits. Turn any idea into a real song—a meme for the group chat, a love song for your person, or a track the whole world vibes to. Whatever you hear in your head, Treblo helps you make it. CREATE IN SECONDS Describe your song. Pick a style. Hit generate. That's it. Want more control? Tweak lyrics, tags, and settings whenever you want. MAKE IT YOURS Extend tracks. Swap sections. Upload audio to cover. Craft until it's perfect. SHARE & DISCOVER Post your music. Follow other artists. Join groups. Remix what inspires you. Build your audience. Hyperpop. Drift phonk. Sea shanties. If you can imagine it, you can create it. Privacy Policy: https://treblo.com/privacy Terms of Service: https://treblo.com/tos

title: Text Dungeon: Roguelite
summary: A dungeon to die in, and three stories to play through. Offline, no ads. Text Dungeon is a turn-based text roguelike and a branching gamebook in one app. READ THE FIGHT Every enemy shows its next move: Attack, Heavy or Guard. Defend against a Heavy and you block all of it and get energy back. Attacking builds energy for your skills. Fights are short, and every turn is a decision. QUICK PLAY Pick a class and a perk, then go down. Eight rooms and a boss: fights, elites, traps, shops, shrines, treasure and rest. Death ends the run, and the sigils you earn unlock permanent upgrades for the next one. - Ascension: ten harder levels for every class, with bigger sigil rewards. - Class mastery: level up each class for titles and small starting bonuses. - Relic sets: collect matching relics for set bonuses. - Daily Run: one shared dungeon a day with its own twist. Keep your streak going. - Weekly Challenge: one shared run a week with stacked modifiers and its own leaderboard. - Endless: win once and the descent repeats, harder every cycle, until it kills you. - From Dec 1, the Midwinter Descent: a free winter dungeon with two new bosses. STORY MODE Make one character and carry them through a whole arc. Your choices set what happens chapters later, which characters trust you, and which ending you reach. - The Hollow Court: find out what silenced the delvers on the Hollow Road. - The Hungering Wood: the wood took Mosswick in a single season. It did not stop there. - Three Winters: 31 people, 9 barrels, and a steading across the ice that has not lit a fire in 11 days. Five oaths are offered. At most two can be kept. Four endings. The Hollow Court and Three Winters open with a free volume. Everything else is a one-time purchase, or get a whole arc in one Complete bundle. Finish an arc and its relic joins you in Quick Play. Classes: Warrior free; Rogue, Mage, Hexblade and Bloodletter in class packs. Relic packs add new items to the loot. Game Center leaderboards and achievements. NO ADS. NO ACCOUNT. NO SUBSCRIPTION. PLAYS OFFLINE. Paid content is one-time purchases. Privacy Policy: https://hipporasy.dev/roguelite/privacy/ This app uses Apple's Standard End User License Agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

title: Into the Dungeon: Loot & Loop
summary: Descend deeper into the dungeon, one step at a time. Dungeon is a text-based dungeon exploration RPG. Simple controls, deep adventure. ■ Explore the Dungeon Challenge a dungeon spanning 6 underground floors. Each floor has its own theme—caves, ruins, waterways, the demon realm, forbidden depths, and the abyss beyond. Stronger monsters and rarer loot await as you descend. Watch out for traps, find healing fountains, and aim for the deepest floor. ■ Over 95 Types of Monsters Slimes, skeletons, dragons, and more inhabit each floor. Defeated enemies are recorded in your codex. ■ Rich Items & Equipment Over 190 types of items await. Equip weapons, armor, and accessories, then use alchemy to craft powerful gear from collected materials. Enhance your equipment to push its stats even further. ■ Prepare in Town • Shop: Buy and sell items • Alchemist: Combine materials into new items • Dojo: Spend gold to permanently boost your stats • Guild: Accept quests for rewards • Stash: Safely store your items ■ Codex & Lore Encountered monsters and items are recorded in your codex. Collect 100 lore fragments scattered throughout the dungeon and uncover the story of this world. ■ Two Difficulty Modes • Normal: Return to town anytime. Lose 20% gold and 2 items on defeat. • Hard: Limited town returns. Lose 50% gold, all items, and EXP on defeat—but all EXP gains are doubled. ■ Perfect For • Fans of text RPGs and roguelikes • Players who enjoy progressing in short sessions • Collectors who love filling out a codex • Anyone craving retro RPG atmosphere Pick up and play with one hand. Your next adventure awaits in the dungeon.

title: AXE DESCENT
summary: Roguelite × Turn-Based Command RPG Over 600 skills. Countless combinations. A different challenge every run. Build your own strategy from randomly presented skills and equipment. Chain skills together, combine them with equipment, and decide how to spend your limited resources. What you get may be random—but how you use it is up to you. A roguelite turn-based command RPG packed with countless choices and immense freedom. ■ Build Your Deck with Over 600 Skills There are over 600 skills to discover. Defeat enemies and choose one skill from a random selection to add to your deck. The skills you find will differ every run. Make the most of what you find, or strengthen the strategy you've already built. Shape your deck through every choice and fight your way to the deepest reaches of the Rift. ■ Weapon × Will × Potion In addition to improving your base stats by leveling up, you can equip three types of equipment: Weapons, Wills, and Potions. Combining skills and equipment can create a wide variety of powerful synergies. Each type of equipment can be upgraded at its own dedicated Facility. But you won't always have enough resources to upgrade everything to its fullest potential. Decide where to invest your limited resources and shape a build that complements your current deck. ■ Conquer the Ever-Changing Rift The Rift is the dungeon at the heart of the game, where a variety of elements change with every run. Skills obtained from enemies. Equipment found in treasure chests. NPCs encountered along the way. Facilities available during your journey. You never know exactly what you'll find, and every choice can lead your build in a new direction. Conquering Rifts rewards you with special items, unlocking new features and new stages to challenge. ■ Build Freely at the Preparation Base Before entering the Rift, the Preparation Base lets you freely customize various elements, including your starting deck and equipment. Do you build around a specific strategy from the beginning? Or create a versatile foundation and adapt to whatever you find along the way? Combine careful preparation with the unpredictable choices of each run to forge your path forward. ■ Random Encounters and Companions A variety of NPC encounters await you within the Rift. Battles, trades, events—and sometimes, the opportunity to recruit an NPC as a Companion. The abilities of your Companions are also randomized. Every encounter has the potential to change the course of your run. ■ Design Your Own Custom Skills Progress even further to unlock Custom Skills, allowing you to freely design the performance of a skill itself. Customize basic properties such as power and number of attacks, then add special effects that trigger when the skill is activated. The activation cost is calculated in detail based on the effects and values you choose, meaning more powerful effects require a greater cost. Create a single devastating strike. Combine multiple effects. Don't just choose from existing skills—create the skill you need yourself. The further you progress, the more possibilities open up for building your own unique playstyle.

title: AGNow,
summary: Audiogames usually have to be downloaded, installed and kept up to date, and most of them only run on Windows. AGNow runs them for you instead: the game runs on the server, and you hear it and play it from wherever you are, without installing anything. • Nothing to install. Games play in the browser. There are also apps for Windows, Mac and iPhone if you would rather have one. • Your own screen reader does the talking. What a game would say to NVDA is passed to the screen reader you already use, in your voice and at your speed. • Your progress is kept. Saved games stay on the server, so you can start on one device and carry on from another. • Short breaks are fine. Leave a game running and it will still be there when you get back, rather than having to be started again. It is for stepping away rather than for tomorrow, though — a game nobody comes back to is closed after a while. • Nobody has to play alone. Add friends, send messages, and let people listen in on what you are playing — or hand them a turn. • Free to play, within reason. A free account gets 12 hours of play time a month, a new one plays without a limit for its first 30 days, and there is a paid tier if you want no limit at all.

title: Path of Adventure 2
summary: When you discover a trail of old cairns, little do you know that you've just set out on the Path of Adventure. The fabled Path, though now mostly forgotten, winds through dungeons and wild lands, past monsters and traps — all the way down into the Undeep. How far will you come? - No ads - Offline - Standalone sequel (you don't need to have played part 1) Path of Adventure 2 is a text-based roguelike RPG. A unique blend of CYOA and D&D! Text-based Step into a fantasy narrative and decide how YOU want to act. Will you dare to leap over the snake pit? Explore that gloomy cave? And what will you offer the ancient statue? Roguelike The path is procedurally generated using random events, enemies and loot. Each death teaches you more about the world, bringing you closer to a well-deserved victory. RPG Develop your character's Strength, Dexterity, and Intelligence, and gather the best gear to match. Manage resources, inflict status effects, and defeat monsters in turn-based combat. Easy to learn, hard to master Never played a game like this before? No problem! Just start with the tutorial and continue your journey. New characters and game modes unlock as you play; plenty of challenge awaits! Accessible Path of Adventure 2 is optimized for screen readers, thanks to the support of the community of blind and visually impaired players.
